title: Frosted orbit
description: A satin glass disk softens the intersection of persimmon and plum.
useCase: Glass material studies, cosmetics, or product-reveal masks with deliberate color blocking.
reducedMotion: A representative frame remains still. Live system preference changes immediately stop the loop; the range control continues to update the still image.
limitations: Requires WebGL 1. A static CSS fallback appears when unavailable or after context loss. Blurs only included procedural artwork. Does not blur arbitrary DOM or use physical volumetric glass.
look: Warm sand-beige ground with overlapping flat persimmon-orange and deep plum circles, and a frosted glass disc with a bright rim blurring their intersection.
motion: A frosted glass disc drifts on a slow, small looping path over two flat circles, blurring what lies beneath; a roughness slider widens or narrows the blur; a button pauses.
adapt: In the `FRAGMENT` shader, `center` sets the disc's `u_time` drift, the 36-sample loop blurs `art` with radius `.025+u_control*.055`, and `mask` sets the 0.25 disc radius. Replace `art` with your own shapes or texture; keep the canvas lifecycle and fallback.
